purpose: Candidate-specific identity verification after the existing retrieval-confidence gate.

selection_rule.strong_rule: A canonical/alias name must occur as a complete entity in the scene description without a conflicting, explicitly named focus entity, or an existing KB visual attribute must match exactly in that focus description.
selection_rule.weak_rule: A contextual name mention or a name embedded in a longer entity is retained for audit only and cannot accept a symbol.

unique_attribute.description: Only exact matches to an existing visual_features component are considered; generic category words are excluded.

focus_conflict.description: A complete candidate name in contextual text is not identity proof when the focus clause explicitly names another entity; this avoids parent-place and name-prefix matches.

notes: No reference_images are populated in the current KB; identity_reference_image_match must remain unavailable.
The gate does not use test labels or test-specific rules.
